purpose.summary: This program is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt software) system used by Japanese medical institutions. It implements system management / automatic calculation information settings (screen W07), handling configuration parameters for outpatient management, time-surcharge checks, hospitalization initial-visit fees, drug information provision fees, and various other medical billing control flags. It is a screen-driven configuration/settings maintenance program.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance receipt processing)

verdict.notes: The file is encoded in latin-1 but the Japanese comments are actually EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, causing mojibake in the displayed text. The program is clearly production-grade medical software from the open-source ORCA project maintained by the Japan Medical Association. The 'online' classification is based on the screen SPA structure and CALL-based middleware pattern typical of ORCA, not CICS. No COMP-3 usage detected despite medical/financial domain, which is consistent with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL usage. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of ~477KB total.
